question: Which company has been given the responsibility of construction, operation and maintenance of the Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) pipeline project?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gas Authority of India (GAIL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **GAIL (India)** Limited oversees the **Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) pipeline project**, managing its construction, operation, and maintenance.
 
• Established in 1984 as a Central Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas (MoP&NG), GAIL plays a pivotal role in India's energy sector.
 
• The HVJ pipeline project, initiated in 1986, ranks among the largest natural gas pipeline endeavors globally.
 
• Its primary objective was to provide gas supply to fertilizer plants in Uttar Pradesh.
